origin: new real-condition execution-check checkpoint, not a manuscript historical weight

training.data: one 10x mouse-pup donor, registered tile 3_10, same tile as bundled inference
training.split: train only; no independent validation or test
training.optimizer_state: saved outside repository beside original training checkpoint, not bundled

conditions.he_st: same measured Xenium mouse-pup tile and registered field
conditions.masks: 68 occupancy planes selected from official 10x polygons; not all cells
conditions.morphology: registered native H&E and official 10x nuclear labels, 16x16 density/nuclear size/shape/hematoxylin texture; cell polygons separately support consistency masks
conditions.reference: 256 P0 muscle cells from independent Cao et al. atlas, two donors, full raw count gene universe before selection
conditions.scgpt: official spatial v1 with 153 of 153 required encoder tensors matched; mouse-to-human ortholog mapping
conditions.gigapath: official gated tile encoder, 257 native H&E vectors
conditions.biobert: pinned official v1.1 frozen; actual metadata plus five genes
conditions.coexpression: existing read-only 50-gene prior from same training tile; not independent
conditions.task_diagnostics: spatial_v1: measured capture sparsity, ST/H&E edge mismatch and between-cell expression mixing; physical resolution read from per-sample st_resolution.json

original_st_resolution.source: Registered pre-degradation HR_ST_256.npz: 2560 um field / 256 bins; raw Xenium transcript positions are finer

conditions.resolution_backbone_gate: 0.3.1 software routing adds a shared-backbone residual only above 10 um; bundled source is exactly 10 um, so its trained path and state tensors are unchanged

expected_output: one five-channel normalized-expression NPZ and five-panel PNG after 1000 DDIM reverse steps
limitations: single training tile; no held-out accuracy
selected 68 official cells rather than full cell set
cross-species ortholog mapping for scGPT vocabulary
